blocks.text:
24 October. As the towers of São Paulo give way to the emerald folds of the Atlantic Forest, the road itself becomes part of the adventure. Watch the landscape transform outside your window until the air turns salty and the first glimpse of the sea confirms what your heart already knows: you are arriving in the Marvelous City.

Transfer from São Paulo to Rio de Janeiro with an English-speaking guide. Accommodation at Ibis Copacabana Posto 5, Standard room + BB, or a similar hotel.
